D1 runtime provider proof maps workspace_homebase_summary to this fixture: sampleCount=9, budget=600ms. Workspace summary read model should stay within one grouped D1 query plus authorization guard.
D1 runtime provider proof maps project_estimate_list_summaries to this fixture: sampleCount=9, budget=600ms. Project estimate list should avoid per-estimate follow-up queries.
D1 runtime provider proof maps estimate_row_mutation to this fixture: sampleCount=9, budget=500ms. Estimate row mutation should stay as one indexed D1 update against an authorized proof row.
D1 runtime provider proof maps library_overview_summary to this fixture: sampleCount=9, budget=600ms. Library overview should stay as a grouped indexed read-model query.

Hosted upload runtime proof covers the secret-gated non-mutating Cloudflare upload runtime route with R2 binding reachability, bounded body probe, and concurrency probe: runs=5, concurrency=3, routeP95=2850.11ms, storageProbeP95=760ms. It does not return uploaded bytes or bearer secrets and does not prove full real-user upload UX/scanner/CDR behavior.
Jobs runtime proof covers Queue send, consumer receipt, cron provider execution, and sanitized end-to-end queue receipt latency: sampleCount=1, p95=33537ms.

Durable Object WebSocket proof opened two hosted clients and verified peer presence plus broadcast delivery: sampleCount=9, presenceP95=54ms, broadcastP95=53ms. Proof-scale only; monthly WebSocket duration/message/storage volume still comes from rollout usage.

Cloudflare Email Service proof sent one arbitrary-recipient message from archestimator.com and verified owner-mailbox receipt by unique subject. This is a send-to-receipt proof-scale sample, not a bounce/event webhook p95.
